title_sq: Ne Fresk, Shitet Dyqan Perfekt Per Investim!!
description_sq: Ne Fresk Shitet Dyqan Perfekt Per Investim!! Dyqani me siperfaqe totale 42 m2, ndodhet ne fillim te rruges se teleferikut dhe ka fasade xhami nga rruga kryesore, e cila i jep nje mundesi shume te mire reklamimi per biznesin qe deshironi te zhvilloni dhe organizohet si nje ambjent i vetem openspace dhe nje tualet. Ambjenti aktualisht funksionon si klinike dentare prej disa vitesh por qe eshte i pershtatshem per tipologji te ndryshme biznesi, si qender estetike, farmaci klinika te ndryshme etj. Dyqani aktualisht eshte i dhene me qira 25000 leke neto prej disa vitesh. Ka orientim drejt Jugut. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In Fresk, Perfect Store for Investment for Sale!!
description_en: Perfect store for investment in Fresk!! The shop with a total area of ​​42 m2, is located at the beginning of the cable car road and has a glass facade from the main road, which gives it a very good advertising opportunity for the business you want to develop and is organized as a single open space and a toilet. The facility is currently operating as a dental clinic for several years, but it is suitable for different types of business, such as an aesthetic center, pharmacy, different clinics, etc. The store is currently rented for 25,000 lek net for several years. It is oriented towards the South. The property has full mortgage documentation.
